description: Two concurrent claimLease calls for one claimable job produce exactly one lease and one no-work result.
No interleaving may leave two open leases for the same job and collection cycle.
Submission, extension, and abandonment by a worker other than the lease holder are refused without disclosing lease state.
Concurrent submissions with the same lease, input hash, and result hash yield one acceptance and byte-identical replays.
A different input or result hash for a lease with an accepted row conflicts and cannot overwrite that row.
Lease expiry and same-cycle requeue are one transaction with no observable expired-but-not-requeued interval.
A result-level requeue terminalizes the old cycle and creates exactly one next cycle atomically.
The new collection cycle, current permit epoch, and recomputed input hash become visible together or not at all.
Replica listing for a new collection cycle never returns accepted evidence from an earlier cycle.
Concurrent authorization calls sharing an effect intent ID create one identity; exact inputs replay and different inputs conflict.
Concurrent verdicts for one adjudication request persist at most one canonical verdict and one terminal transition.
Concurrent reserve charges with the same charge key consume capacity exactly once.
Two authorizations racing for a lane's final unit yield one authorized and charged result plus one escalation-budget denial, never overdraw or uncharged authorization.
